- Clients try to catch something that is not a prize
- Machines cannot be placed

notes.title: Update # 21 & Apology & Notice
notes.content:
- Clients' intellect has been slightly improved
- Now it is possible to delete saved machines
- Now it is possible to add prizes (β)
- Other minor changes
(Please wait for a while for the "time stop during play" function)

Finally, you can make and add prizes
It takes a little time, but here is the creation and addition guide
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2671047162

We are also planning to use Steam Workshop in the future



= Apology =
An error has been comprobed for a long time, that the clients overlap
We are currently investigating this. We apologize for the inconvenience



= Notice =
We are planning to raise the price starting next year, as a lot of features have now been added compared to the initial release (I will correct the defects as much as possible)
But there are chances that it will be in promotion once again this year


If you find any flaws let me know
